name: label-bitfield-editor-rows
title: Label the bit-field and enum editor rows
description: Add a visible column-header row above the bit-field child rows (Name/Bits/Enum/Hide) and the enum entry rows (Name/Value) in the struct type editor, so the unlabeled inputs are self-explanatory, and add the missing aria-labels to those inputs. Editor-only UI; no persisted shape, decode, or schema change.
